faqs.q: Why not convert images with a free online converter?
faqs.a: An image can carry as much personal information as a document; uploading it just to change a file extension means trusting a server with all of that.

faqs.q: Can I convert several images at once?
faqs.a: Yes — drop as many as you like; each file's progress is shown individually.

faqs.q: Can it convert images to AVIF or WebP, not just PNG and JPEG?
faqs.a: Yes — DevUtils has no general image converter, and DevToys' image tool is currently PNG/JPEG only (AVIF/WebP support is an open feature request as of this writing). Umbra converts to PNG, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF today.
